title: GLM 5.2 Performance Benchmarks
summary: GLM 5.2 is a large language model from Chinese AI company Zhipu AI (智谱AI), and this content presents its performance benchmarks comparing it against other leading AI models on artificialanalysis.ai, a platform that tracks and analyzes AI model performance metrics.
problem_solved: Provides quantitative performance data to compare GLM 5.2 against other state-of-the-art language models.
why_valuable: Enables researchers and developers to make informed decisions about model selection based on objective benchmark comparisons.
